name: UploadImageToWixSite
description:
Upload one or more images to a Wix site's Media Manager. Returns wixstatic.com URL and media ID.
Do NOT use ExecuteWixAPI or code execution for image uploads — use this tool directly.

Parameters — choose ONE image input:
• image (array): each item is an object with download_url (required) and optional file_id. Pass ALL images in one call.
• imageBase64 (string): base64-encoded image + mimeType. One image at a time.

siteId.description: The ID of the Wix site to upload to

displayName.description: Optional display name for the file in Media Manager. If not provided, uses the original filename.

image.description: Array of images, each with download_url and optionally file_id. Use this when the user provides image file attachments OR image URLs. ALWAYS pass ALL images together in a single call — NEVER call this tool once per image. User-attached files are automatically resolved to download_urls — just include them here. Do NOT use together with imageBase64.

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image data. Use when the client can read a file and encode it as base64. May include a data URL prefix (e.g. "data:image/jpeg;base64,...") or be raw base64. Do NOT use together with image.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g. "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"). Required when imageBase64 does not include a data URL prefix.
